class.name: GDCubismValueAbs
class.brief_description: Base resource for legacy parameter and part-opacity values.
class.description: Stores a cached ID and value associated with a native model parameter or part. The model invalidates this resource on unload or replacement; retained references remain readable. Use [method is_valid] before expecting a write to affect a live model.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: False after the model is unloaded or replaced. A retained resource keeps its cached value and cannot write through an expired native pointer.

members.member: Read-only native parameter or part ID.
Cached numeric value. Assignments mark it for application during the legacy model update while the native reference remains valid. After invalidation, changes affect only the retained resource.
